notes.title: Balancing Update
notes.content: [p]Hey folks! [/p][p][/p][p]Here's the monthly update. It's not a super big update, mainly just balancing stuff to try and make the game feel a bit better to play. There were also a few bug fixes/polish things added which you can read the details of below.[/p][p]The TL;DR is Mage got buffed, Archer got a slight buff, and Warrior was nerfed. Mage felt awful to play before, while warrior felt too easy. The warrior is still the easiest because the shielding ability is super useful for getting past enemies quickly especially with speed boots, but it should at least be a little tougher to get through.[/p][p]Almost all enemies had stat updates as well. Some were strengthened while some were weakened. A lot of our enemies had the same stats which we didn't think made sense since they were different enemies. The biggest one is we gave the final boss more damage and higher health. We wanted the boss to be harder to kill and hit a little harder to make collecting health a bit more important leading up to the boss.[/p][p][/p][h2]Details[/h2][h3]Hero balancing:[/h3][p]Mage stats:[/p][p]	- Normal speed: 200 > 225[/p][p]	- Attack cooldown: 0.3s > 0.2s[/p][p]	- Base health: 500 > 450[/p][p]	- Special cooldown: 5s > 4s[/p][p]Archer stats:[/p][p]	- Base health: 300 > 350[/p][p]	- Special cooldown: 8s > 7s[/p][p]Warrior stats:[/p][p]	- Normal speed: 225 > 200[/p][p]	- Attack cooldown: 0.5s > 0.4s[/p][p]	- Base health: 800 > 600[/p][p]	- Special cooldown: 6.5s > 6s[/p][p]	- Special length: 3s > 2s[/p][p]	[/p][h3]Enemy balancing:[/h3][p]All projectile damage was increased from 1 to 3 minus the boss[/p][p]Boss:[/p][p]	- Health: 200 > 300[/p][p]	- Damage: 25 > 40[/p][p]	- Projectile damage: 1 > 10[/p][p]Bone Shaman:[/p][p]	- Health: 10 > 12[/p][p]	- Damage: 10 > 8[/p][p]Dread Knight:[/p][p]	- Damage: 50 > 25[/p][p]Shadow Elf:[/p][p]	- Health: 7 > 10[/p][p]Child Slime:[/p][p]	- Health: 5 > 3[/p][p]	- Damage: 10 > 5[/p][p]Mama Slime:[/p][p]	- Health: 5 > 8[/p][p]	- Damage: 10 > 12[/p][p]Skeleton:[/p][p]	- Health: 5 > 4[/p][p]Zombie:[/p][p]	- Health: 5 > 6[/p][p]Silkworm:[/p][p]	- Health: 5 > 4[/p][p]	- Shoot cooldown range: 5s to 10s > 2s to 5s[/p][p]Pebbler:[/p][p]	- Health: 5 > 4[/p][p][/p][h3]Bug fixes and polish:[/h3][p]- Enemies should no longer get shot out of map by mage and warrior specials[/p][p]- Can no longer click pause menu buttons from options menu in game (got rid of background from pause menu as a result, don't know why it was added to begin with...)[/p][p]- Corrected some levels that were incorrect sizes leading to various bugs[/p][p]- Corrected wrong song sometimes loading when continuing game[/p][p]- Added icon timers for the various powerups[/p]

notes.title: QoL Update + Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello!

Today we will be releasing our first regular update, the exact contents of which are listed below. The main thing is the button remapping we've added for those who prefer a different control scheme, as well as auto saves. The saves happen every time you go to a new level. The saves should be instant but you should wait a second or two before quitting just to be safe.

Moving forward we have plans to do some balancing of hero and enemy stats, add achievements, and add a new hero to play as! We don't have a particular order we plan on doing these in but you can expect a regular update from us every month until we complete the above.

Thanks for playing!
NEETNectar Team

[h3]QoL Features Added:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Button remapping
[*] Lock mouse option
[*] Auto saves between levels
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Main menu buttons no longer clickable from other windows
[*] Player no longer picks up items when loading into new levels
[*] Boss now switches to death animation if killed while charging
[*] Boss no longer loses speed when charge gets interrupted
[/list]
